name: dsh-app
description: DSH APP — branded desktop client for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). macOS / Windows / Linux.

scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-bundled-kernel.mjs && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-bundled-kernel.mjs win32 && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-bundled-kernel.mjs darwin && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-bundled-kernel.mjs linux && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win:arm64: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-bundled-kernel.mjs win32 arm64 && electron-builder --win --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-bundled-kernel.mjs darwin arm64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-bundled-kernel.mjs linux arm64 && electron-builder --linux --arm64
